_note: Pre-walked segments loaded on first boot when the DB is empty. Coordinates are on real Delhi streets; hazard entries are hand-recorded scaffolding for the demo map and should be replaced by segments walked with the Contribute tab. Photos are not bundled.

segments.name: Kashmere Gate Metro Gate 3 to Lothian Rd

photos.observations: Pavers lifted along the metro boundary wall, drain uncovered near the auto stand.
Auto-rickshaws parked across the footpath at the metro exit.

hazards.note: 180 mm kerb, no ramp at the crossing

segments.name: Lothian Rd to Old Delhi Railway Station

photos.observations: Concrete footpath, cracked but continuous. Electric pole mid-path.

segments.name: Chandni Chowk: Fatehpuri Masjid to Town Hall

photos.observations: Redeveloped pedestrian street, granite paving, level throughout, tactile strip present.
Vendor carts along the edge but wide clear path remains.

segments.name: Netaji Subhash Marg along Red Fort wall

photos.observations: Wide footpath, some standing water at the low point near the bus stop.

hazards.note: No guiding tiles on the whole run

segments.name: Mall Road, Civil Lines near Metro

photos.observations: Well laid interlocking pavers, kerb ramps at both ends, one low branch.

segments.name: Rajpur Rd, Civil Lines market stretch

photos.observations: Cars parked nose-in over the footpath for the whole market frontage.

hazards.note: Continuous parking, forces walking on the carriageway

segments.name: Connaught Place Outer Circle, Block M to N

photos.observations: Colonnaded arcade, smooth stone, level access; steps at the colonnade ends without ramps.

hazards.note: Three steps down to the road, no ramp

segments.name: Barakhamba Rd, Metro to Tolstoy Marg

photos.observations: Transformer enclosure occupies half the footpath; pavers broken around it.

hazards.note: Fenced transformer, 1.1 m left to pass
Loose tiles at the transformer base

segments.name: Janpath, Tolstoy Marg to Janpath Market

photos.observations: Market stalls extend onto the footpath; surface itself is sound.

hazards.note: Stalls take 1.5 m of a 2.8 m footpath

segments.name: Mandi House to ITO, Tansen Marg side

photos.observations: Construction hoarding for a building site, debris spilled across the path.

hazards.note: Sand and aggregate heap across 4 m
